title: Arizona secretary of state expands AI chatbot ahead of midterm elections
summary: Arizona's secretary of state said his office's expanded chatbot is designed to augment the work of human agents and provide off-hours access to reliable information.

title: All 50 states have joined ‘Home for Every Child’ initiative, a data-driven plan to improve foster-care ratios
summary: All 50 states have now joined "Home for Every Child," an initiative that uses new digital technologies with the aim of improving child welfare.

title: North Carolina takes first steps to modernize state hiring practices in more than 60 years, starting with IT
summary: The state's human resources director said her office is employing "tech best practices" to revamp how the state recruits and retains staff.

title: ‘Technology is the easy part’: Washington, D.C., turned to collaboration, data governance for America 250
summary: With numerous 250th anniversary events packed into a few months, officials in Washington, D.C., said this summer has presented a "unique" challenge in terms of technology, communications and emergency management.

title: Illinois governor signs AI safety law requiring audits of frontier models
summary: The Artificial Intelligence Safety Measures Act requires developers of the most advanced AI models to yield to new levels of state oversight.

title: Washington state CISO announces retirement from government
summary: After decades working for county and state governments, Ralph Johnson has announced he'll pursue work advising the public sector on matters of cybersecurity.

title: One year after devastating Texas floods, adoption of warning systems remains uneven
summary: A year after catastrophic flooding in Texas's Hill Country exposed critical gaps in emergency warning systems, state and local officials are expanding efforts in flood detection technology.

title: Digital identity, IT modernization and procurement feature in California’s new budget
summary: California's $351.7 billion budget for the coming fiscal year continues spending on numerous major technology projects already underway.

title: Idaho CIO appointed state transportation director
summary: Alberto Gonzalez, who's been serving as Idaho's chief information officer for nearly four years, will take a new role as the state's transportation director.

title: State, local cyber grant funding can’t be used on ‘bundled’ services from membership groups, FEMA clarifies
summary: The Federal Emergency Management Agency has clarified that state and local governments can use federal cyber grant funding to pay for services from membership organizations, provided they aren't "bundled."
